name: Arthus
backstory: Harper Arthus is a gruff high half-elf barbarian and Harper in Act Two. Trusted with the possession of a Mind Flayer Parasite, he interrupts the party when they land refugees from the Moonrise Towers Prison at the Last Light Inn docks, checking them for signs of the Absolute's infection.
